claim: The one-click sample week uses separate demo storage, can be reset, and never changes the user's real archive.
sandbox: fresh browser context; create one real block; enter /demo; mutate and reset sample; return to the untouched real block; assert demo store is empty on exit

claim: The weekly board adds, edits, copies, deletes, restores, and recalls the client for a known project.
sandbox: fresh /demo; use shipped project mapping; add, edit, copy, delete, and undo a work block

claim: Calendar files are reviewed and imported locally, including bounded recurrences and overnight events; descriptions and billability require explicit choices.
where: how it works, local data section, README
sandbox: fresh /demo; import a local fixture with recurrence, private description, and overnight event; assert results, defaults, demo-only IndexedDB, and no off-origin requests

claim: Exports the selected week as an invoice-ready CSV with one row per visible work block.
sandbox: fresh /demo sample week; download CSV; assert filename, complete header, row count, and sample fields

claim: Exports, erases, and restores the complete local JSON archive.
sandbox: fresh /demo; export JSON; erase demo archive; restore downloaded file; assert sample returns

claim: Works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: fresh /demo on isolated service-worker origin; wait for control; go offline; reload; assert sample board and offline status

claim: The optional $18 one-time Pattern Deck saves reusable blocks and copies the previous week; core tools remain free.
sandbox: fresh /demo with paid preview enabled; save a pattern; clone three prior blocks; assert current count and price/free-tier copy
